current.text: Curry has said publicly that his knee issue is a new normal.
Experts keep worrying about his knee, and that worry is the main reason they rank him below his per game level.
One expert expects he could miss 30 games this season.
Experts see him as a top 10 to 13 player per game in category leagues. One values his per game line at about 40 USD.

Experts disagree on his draft price. One finds a rank of 25 fair in category leagues if his knee is fine. One would not pay more than 25 USD in an auction. Another would not take him that early in a normal 9-cat draft.
Experts still call him one of the best players in the league at age 38.
He is the only player on the Warriors who really creates his own shot.
He is expected to carry a huge offensive load because the roster lacks creators.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year.
Experts call the Warriors a bad team. One worries the team is bad enough to cut his minutes or rest veterans for lottery odds, and another expects Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs this season, tied for the second most.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end on March 28.

durable.text: He is much more valuable in category leagues than in points leagues.
His three-point volume is a league outlier and steady, with 4.4 threes per game in each of the last two seasons.
He is a consistent 92 to 93 percent free throw shooter on real volume, which lifts a team's FT%.
His scoring is a league outlier.
His assists and steals are not particularly good.
Turnovers are his weak category for a guard, at about 2.7 per game.
He has runner's knee, a wear-and-tear issue that cost him games late last season. Injury is the main fantasy risk with him.
Expect maintenance rest days because of the knee.

note: Experts value Curry's per game line near 40 USD, and his threes, points and FT% are true league outliers. The knee, his age of 38 and a gap-year Warriors team drag his price down to Yahoo 31 USD and ESPN 21 USD, well below the 42 USD he cost in our league last season, and one auction expert caps him at 25 USD. He fits punt TO and threes-heavy guard builds. A bid in the mid to high 20s makes sense if you accept the risk of 15 to 30 missed games. Early in the season, watch his knee, any rest days on the 15 back-to-backs, and whether the Warriors start to look like a lottery team.
